summary: Frontend-only end-to-end test of Group 1 changes: (a) modernized Login/Register right panel, (b) story AJAX upload form, (c) AJAX deletes (seller auction + admin category), (d) Seller Dashboard 'Canlı Yayına Başla' card + sidebar broadcast shortcut, (e) 'Canlı İzle' tab hidden on non-live auctions. All 9 review scenarios pass. Home 200 OK with 23 auction links, login redirects sellers to /seller/dashboard, delete flows are true AJAX (URL unchanged, row count decrements, toast visible, no full-page reload), and auction detail correctly hides the stream tab with d-none.

issues: Stat cards on top (TOPLAM/AKTİF/ANA KAT.) still show old count (4) after row removed; only tbody row is fadeOut. Not functional — cosmetic only.
Seed data still triggers many 403 image errors in console (~40 per navigation); image-fallback.js substitutes placeholder correctly — inherited from iteration_1, not a Group-1 regression.

login_page.right_panel_text_snippet: Şu an 13 aktif ilan | Artirdim | LIVE / 24/7 / +1K | En hızlı teklif sistemi | 256-bit SSL, Onaylı Satıcılar, 7/24 Destek

seller_dashboard.card_text: Canlı Yayına Başla — 1 aktif ilanın kamera açmayı bekliyor — 'Antika Masa Saati ve Vaz...' için yayın aç

admin_categories_ajax_delete.note: Form has class 'delete-form' (not 'js-delete-form') but global ajaxDeleteForm handler still intercepts it correctly.

action_items: (Optional) After admin AJAX delete, also decrement the header stat cards (TOPLAM / AKTİF / ANA KAT.) — currently they remain at pre-delete count until page reload.

(Optional) Rename the admin delete form class from 'delete-form' to 'js-delete-form' for consistency with the file reference note in the task description; currently the global handler works but the class hint in review_request is misleading.
(Cosmetic, carried over from iteration_1) Fix seed image URLs to eliminate 403 console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Global window.ajaxDeleteForm + window.ajaxToast pattern in ajax-delete.js works cleanly and is reused across seller & admin flows — good separation.

seller-live-card correctly reads active-listing count and links to the specific auction slug for a single listing; would benefit from a .seller-live-list variant when multiple active listings exist (only 1 active during test so list-mode not exercised).
d-none guard on #tab-stream is properly server-rendered (is_live=0 + stream_mode=live) — good.
SweetAlert2 emits 'The parameter heightAuto is incompatible with toasts' warning — harmless but should be removed from toast() call for cleanliness.

Two pageerror('Unexpected token !') fired during navigation — likely from an inline template snippet that mishandles `!` inside a JS string; low severity but should be traced (search for uncleaned Blade `@` output inside <script>).
seed_data_creation: none — used existing seeded auctions/categories. Two rows were AJAX-deleted during the run (1 seller auction, 1 admin category 'Mücevherat').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group 1 changes are functionally green. If retesting: (1) login/register right panel — check .auth-right, .auth-brand-*, .auth-stat-*, .auth-hero-*; (2) seller dashboard — .seller-live-card + [data-testid='sidebar-seller-broadcast'] + typeof window.ajaxDeleteForm==='function'; (3) AJAX delete — click .pf-action-btn-delete.js-delete-btn (seller) or form.delete-form button (admin), then .swal2-confirm, then verify URL unchanged AND tbody tr count decreased by 1; (4) auction detail — document.getElementById('tab-stream').classList.contains('d-none') must be true when is_live=0; (5) story — #storyUploadForm exists, action=/stories, and dispatching a synthetic submit event returns false (preventDefault called). Two seeded rows were deleted during this run (1 seller auction + admin category 'Mücevherat') — DB state changed.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs blocking. Minor observations captured under action_items / critical_code_review_comments.
